scope: Three Barranco public-space dossiers separating repeatable civic service, active closed restoration and uncertain cliff-overlook recovery.

sources.supports: Current CIAM service, 150–200 daily attendances, 28 workshops, hours and Barranco civic-facility network; outdoor visibility is not guaranteed.
Free cultural programming in Parque Municipal and other public spaces; no current event date inferred.
Library/former town hall, park and church civic ensemble identity and architectural context.
Site handover 2026-06-05, closed work condition, contract and 480-day execution horizon.
Restoration start and intervention to roofs, walls, towers, domes, services and accessible ramp; phase visibility requires same-day check.
1988 cliff-edge overlook, pubs/restaurants, lower pedestrian path and visitor activities; record updated in source registry 2025 but conditions remain field checks.
Municipal recovery project for tourist services at Mirador Catalina Recavarren with programmed investment; does not prove completion.
Cliff-edge construction, coastal view, visitor use and municipal identity; picturesque/sunset framing is a saturation warning.

contradictions: CIAM documents high daily service use across two district sites, but it does not prove that any named workshop is visible outdoors in Parque Municipal.
Free cultural programming proves episodic stage capacity, not a current event window or permission to photograph performers.
composition_questions: Can everyday movement between park paths, former town-hall library and current social/cultural service make Barranco's civic ensemble read as active infrastructure?
Which vendor canopy, tourist group, parked vehicle or temporary stage would sever the park path from its civic destination?
Does moving to a path/threshold diagonal reveal civic distribution better than widening the familiar library-church panorama?

source_truth.answer: Parque Municipal is Barranco's historic civic core, structured by park paths and public buildings including the former town hall/current library and parish church.

original_spatial_contract.answer: A central public landscape distributed residents among municipal, religious and social functions, with façades and paths forming a civic room.

current_life.answer: People cross, wait, read, socialize and receive services while the park periodically hosts free culture; exact visible activity must be observed, not scheduled from generic programs.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Cross, sit, read, meet, practice, learn, perform and watch are credible. The strongest repeatable verb is crossing or waiting between civic destinations.

architectural_causality.answer: Path intersections, benches, porticoes and facing civic façades distribute bodies and convert open park space into a shared institutional threshold.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Library-church panorama, fountain/park postcard and event-stage coverage dominate. The underused frame links ordinary service movement to two civic thresholds.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa can unify mismatched façades and reduce tourist color; low light can turn path geometry and portico shadows into a legible civic network.

position_then_optics.answer: Test central path junction, library-portico diagonal and church/library cross-axis. Start 35 mm for civic room, 50 mm for person/path/destination and 85 mm only where two thresholds remain linked.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Observe ordinary use before relying on events, avoid identifiable children/older adults without consent, keep paths and services clear and fall back to meaningful absence if no causal action emerges.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes when park geometry visibly distributes current civic life. Pretty ensemble, event crowd or tourist scale without a destination relationship fails.

contradictions: Official sources verify a 480-day restoration launched June 2026, but the visible construction phase, barriers and work cadence can change daily.
Future accessible ramp and restored cultural/tourist use are project outcomes, not current use and must not rescue the present frame.
composition_questions: Can a visible conservation operation show how the damaged eighteenth-century church currently reorganizes passage and attention without romanticizing ruin?
Which scaffold screen, ceremony banner, tourist cluster or clipped tower would hide the exact roof/wall/access intervention?
Does moving along the lawful work perimeter reveal old fabric–temporary support–public route causality better than widening the closed façade?

source_truth.answer: La Ermita is Barranco's eighteenth-century foundational church, currently closed and under a formally contracted 480-day restoration begun in June 2026.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Church nave, roof, walls, towers and domes formed a worship and district-origin landmark connected to the descent/coastal route.

current_life.answer: Its present program is conservation work, inspection, protection and public detour—not worship or open tourism; exact work visibility needs same-day confirmation.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Secure, inspect, shore, remove, restore, pass and observe are credible. Meaningful absence of worship is visible only if closure and work devices explain it.

architectural_causality.answer: Damaged roof/walls and work perimeter determine supports, access closure, pedestrian detour and which historic layers remain visible.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Romantic ruin, frontal yellow façade and restoration-launch ceremony dominate. The underused frame isolates a real material intervention and its effect on current passage.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa can join old plaster, exposed material and temporary supports; side light can reveal repaired/unrepaired seams without aestheticizing decay.

position_then_optics.answer: From lawful public edges test work-gate diagonal, side wall/roof seam and passage-to-closed-entry relation. Start 50 mm for work/device, 35 mm for church/detour and 85 mm for safe distant material layering.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Never enter the work zone or obstruct crews, verify barriers and visible operations, avoid identifiable workers without approval and kill the scene if only opaque hoarding or ceremonial signage remains.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes when original fabric visibly forces present conservation or detour. Picturesque ruin, future-promise caption or generic construction documentation fails.

A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Exclude banners, vehicles and clipped tower

contradictions: A municipal recovery project is documented, but available evidence does not prove completion, current barriers or lower-path access.
Older inventory descriptions establish a lower path and hospitality use, while wear and subsequent intervention may have changed every feasible camera position.
composition_questions: Can the overlook terrace, lower path and a pair of observers make Barranco's cliff section visible instead of merely presenting the sunset?
Which railing, pub awning, vegetation, crowd or blown horizon would disconnect upper viewing from lower coastal movement?
Does moving below/side-on to the cliff edge reveal observer-over-path causality better than changing focal length from the sunset rail?

source_truth.answer: Catalina Recavarren is a 1988 public overlook built at Barranco's cliff edge, linked to hospitality uses and historically documented lower circulation.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Terrace, rail, seating and lower circumferential path organize pausing, viewing and movement at different elevations along the coastal section.

current_life.answer: People look, sit, meet, photograph and use adjacent venues while municipal recovery may alter the edge; same-day access and works are mandatory checks.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Look, sit, meet, photograph, descend, pass and dine are credible. The decisive relation is upper observing occurring above or beside lower movement.

architectural_causality.answer: Cliff edge, terrace rail, seating, former infrastructure residue and lower path separate stationary viewing from longitudinal coastal movement.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Sunset horizon, romantic couple and empty panorama dominate. The underused frame turns the overlook itself into a section connecting observers, lower path and city/coast layers.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa suppresses the cliché horizon and reveals rail/terrace/path geometry; side light can separate cliff depth but sunset alone is not a mechanism.

position_then_optics.answer: Verify upper side-on rail, accessible lower/adjacent path and distant Ermita/funicular-layer viewpoint. Start 50 mm for observer/path, 35 mm for full section and 85 mm only if both levels remain legible.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Verify recovery works, rail/path safety and lawful lower access, avoid identifiable couples and unstable edges, cap sunset waiting and fall back to garúa/meaningful absence if two-level action is impossible.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes when built cliff infrastructure visibly separates or connects observing and moving. Sunset, romance, ocean panorama or caption-dependent funicular history fails.
